scope: Native package operator onboarding and managed local surviving-copy recovery; source-only improvement.

readiness.checks: Frontend roles and asset hashes, direct store profiles, direct/gateway/B reads against local stored bytes

reviewFindingsFixed: Store death after readiness previously stopped the surviving recovery route
Startup readiness variable shadowed the ready flag
Child completion differed for failed spawn and disconnected IPC
Repeated terminal and npm-forwarded termination could interrupt cleanup or default-terminate during Node teardown
Failed initialization must preserve replacement directories and competing files
Read transport must stop collecting bytes after cancellation or overflow
limitations: Local processes still share one machine, gateway, recovery frontend and origin
Native device compatibility and public TLS ownership are not proven by this package replay
Readiness consistency is distinct from authenticated plaintext recovery
No external adoption, human usability study, external security audit or prize likelihood claimed
Immutable snapshots require exporting later edits; no automatic repair or key migration
